title: The Fed's rate is 4.25% or lower after April: the rises stop after December, or reverse
html:
Proposition

The Fed's rate is 4.25% or lower after April: the rises stop after December, or reverse

The upper bound of the federal funds target range stands at 4.25% or lower after the FOMC meeting that ends April 28, 2027: at most one more rise net, because inflation cools quickly or because growth or markets crack.
